name: Sunset Salsa Bachata on the Docks 7-10pm
description:
*** BOBAS is Thursday 7-10pm this week ***

We are looking for alternative venues for rainy days. Please see the post on our page for more details. 

*** The weather looks great but please monitor this event page for updates. ***

Bachata playing on one side of the dock and salsa on the other like last time.

Bring water. Please don't forget to take your stuff with you, we always see things left behind. Please don’t put your stuff in front of the speakers, it muffles the sound.

The location is the usual docks behind the Hatch Shell stage:
https://maps.app.goo.gl/ERYQSY3Qy9Pbk5ew6

Please follow the Boston Outdoor Bachata And Salsa page to get notifications about future events.

Check out Havana Thursday after!

***Weather Permitting. Keep an eye on this event page for updates. ***
